subject: Invoice structuring + PO acknowledgement — remittance pathways and net-term alignment
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudmarble.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@cloudmarble.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup — PO fields and invoice layout

Hi Ben / Lauren,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. We're starting vendor onboarding for the infra contract and procurement asked for a standardized invoice example and the exact PO acknowledgement fields Redwood expects. A few constraints from our side:
- Our ERP requires vendor tax ID and a single invoice line per PO number (no split line-items).
- Remittance has to point to a third-party payment processor unless the invoice includes "Remit to: CloudMarble Payments, ACH" on the first page.
- Net terms: our default is Net 45 but we can sign for Net 30 with a 1.5% early-pay discount if Redwood can guarantee invoice delivery within 5 business days of milestone acceptance.

Could you send a sample invoice (PDF/XLS) and a quick checklist of PO acknowledgment fields so our AP team can validate? Happy to loop Samir from our payments team if needed.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Procurement, CloudMarble LLC
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Elena Rossi <elena@cloudmarble.com>, procurement@cloudmarble.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup — PO fields and invoice layout

Elena — thanks for the clarity. Attached are: (1) our recommended invoice template (Sample_INVOICE_template.xlsx) that shows the header fields we need, and (2) a filled CloudMarble_PO_Form.xlsx example. Quick summary of critical PO acknowledgement and invoice requirements from Redwood's side: 
- PO number (mandatory)
- Redwood entity bill-to (we include entity name & remit instructions on the template)
- Line-level descriptions allowed; if you only send a single line per PO that's OK — we will accept it if the PO number maps cleanly to the line.
- Tax ID / W-9 (US vendors) or VAT registration (EU) in onboarding form
- Bank wire + ACH details preferred in a separate remit section (do not place gateway-only references in remit field)

On terms: Net 45 is fine as a standard. For Net 30 with an early-pay discount, we need to confirm the milestone acceptance SLAs and invoice submission timing. Marcus — can you confirm how quickly we can generate acceptance notices once the delivery signoff hits the console?

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Sample_INVOICE_template.xlsx; CloudMarble_PO_Form.xlsx
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Elena Rossi <elena@cloudmarble.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor setup — PO fields and invoice layout

Elena / team — we typically auto-generate acceptance within 24 hours of the QA signoff in the customer console for hosted integrations. For dedicated/on-prem projects where manual QA is required, it can be 2-3 business days. For clarity: acceptance = our internal signoff + ticket closure in the delivery tracker.

If CloudMarble can guarantee invoice delivery within 5 business days of that acceptance event, we can consider Net 30 + 1.5% early-pay. Otherwise Net 45. Also note: if you route payments via a third-party processor (as you mentioned), we need a confirmable remit address printed on the invoice and a signed ACH authorization form during onboarding.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Customer Delivery Operations, Redwood Inference
From: procurement@cloudmarble.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice structuring + PO acknowledgement — remittance pathways and net-term alignment

Thanks — we've reviewed the template. A couple of follow-ups from CloudMarble AP: 
- Can you accept an invoice where remit instructions reference "CloudMarble Payments / ThirdPartyGateway" plus a secondary "Payable To" line that points to the vendor entity? Our system wants the payment destination and the vendor legal name both displayed.
- If we use the early-pay discount (1.5%), do you require any separate enrollment form or is the discount applied automatically at payment run if invoice qualifies?
- We will attach the vendor onboarding PDF you requested (Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf) once internal sign-offs complete.

Samir Patel (cc) — can you confirm whether our payment processor can meet Redwood's "confirmable remit address" requirement?

Regards,
Procurement Team
CloudMarble LLC
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: procurement@cloudmarble.com, Elena Rossi <elena@cloudmarble.com>, Samir Patel <samir@payvendor.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice structuring + PO acknowledgement — remittance pathways and net-term alignment

Elena / Procurement / Samir — quick operational summary and next steps so we can close onboarding this week: 

1) Invoice fields: the attached Sample_INVOICE_template shows the exact header order Redwood AP requires (Vendor legal name, Tax ID, Invoice #, PO #, Invoice date, Due date, Line items / single-line allowed, Remit instructions). If CloudMarble insists on a gateway reference, please include both: (a) Payable To: <vendor legal name> and (b) Remit Via: <gateway name> + Remit Address. That satisfies both systems.

2) Early-pay: Redwood will apply the 1.5% discount automatically at payment run if the invoice meets: (a) Delivered and accepted within our delivery tracker, (b) Invoice submitted within 5 business days of acceptance, and (c) signed ACH/Remit authorization on file. No separate enrollment form required — the onboarding packet will include authorization.

3) PO acknowledgement: please return the completed CloudMarble_PO_Form.xlsx with the required bank/tax fields and a PDF copy of your invoice sample. We'll provision the vendor after we receive those and a signed W-9 or equivalent.

4) Action owners + deadlines:
- CloudMarble (Elena / Procurement): return completed PO form + Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf by Wed 07/28.
- Samir / payments: confirm remit address suitability by Tue 07/27.
- Redwood (Marcus): confirm acceptance SLA for dedicated/on-prem by Tue 07/27 if any deviation from 24-hour auto-ack.

If we hit those targets we can set Net 30 + 1.5% early-pay as the active payment term for this vendor. Thanks all — ping me if anything blocks.

Ben
Ben Carter
Principal Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: Sample_INVOICE_template.xlsx (referenced)
